name: fleet-band
description: Read-only fleet status band above the prompt (seat, context %, Room unread, pending job results, needs-you, held seats) plus /fires, /pending and /held commands that answer with no model turn.

installRoot.title: Install root
installRoot.description: Folder whose daemons/job-results.mjs lists pending job results. Empty: the results field and /fires are off.

roomRoot.title: Room root
roomRoot.description: The Room's room/ folder (inbox/<seat>/, state/<seat>.supervisor.log). Empty: room unread and held are off.

eodPath.title: EOD file
eodPath.description: Path of the EOD latest.json whose needs_you[] is counted. Empty: needs-you is off.

watchedSeats.title: Watched seats
watchedSeats.description: Seat names whose supervisor logs are checked for a held refresh cycle. Empty: held is off.

showSummaries.title: Show result summaries
showSummaries.description: Print each pending result's summary in /fires (off: job and time only).
